title: Opening and introduction in San Diego

blocks.x: We are filming today in San Diego, and it’s a great honor for me to have one of the great saxophone players of our day, James Moody. I am thrilled to be talking to you as you are a person that I listened to on the way up playing myself.
Well thank you. It’s a pleasure to be here.
